title: Share evaluator affiliation while keeping submission-time parent admission separate
outcome: Share evaluator affiliation while keeping submission-time parent admission separate
acceptance: Same-session mark provenance and consume-time author affiliation continue to use the existing shared same_session_ineligibility owner

Tests reject a sub_agent submitted from an executor or former holder session, allow a distinct child with a currently executing parent at admission, and retain that admitted child record after a legitimate parent handoff without requiring the original parent still hold the run

admit_identity and staleness share the independent-session affiliation predicate over current holder, executor and holder history; a test records independently, hands this run to that evaluator, and proves done rejects it

completion.summary: Shared independent evaluator affiliation across admission and consumption without changing same-session provenance or submission-time parent admission. Public handoff regressions and affiliation table pass; full gate, independent reviews and all three acceptance criteria pass.
